bundle.shortDescription: Track work topics and context switches in a local event log
bundle.longDescription: Konzendi records which topic you are working on, when you switch, stop, undo, or correct an entry, in an append-only event log on this computer. It shows a day timeline with plain sums. It has no accounts and no network features.
